items:
A 
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category,
No smoking in battery room or any things leads to fire is permitted

Using safety equipments, and isolated tools, safety goggles, rubber gloves, rubber apron 
and safety boots is necessary

Don't put any tools or metal things on the top of battery (to avoid short 
circuit danger)
Don't use the same tools for maintenance in alkaline cells and acidic cells
Repeat the monthly maintenence according to MPIS document no. B-017-r0

Record the density of electrolyte 
 in each cell 
 (the standard values according to manufacturer are between 
 1.19 & 1.12 gm / cm3), write the values in the maintenance card.
Record the temperature of electrolyte in each cell.

Disconnect AC supply to 
 battery charger.

Immediately after disconnecting AC power supply, 
 Record overall battery voltage every 15 minutes for one hour (i.e 4 times), 
 after that Record overall battery voltage every one hour for 7 hours (i.e 7 
 times)

Measure the voltage in the end of the previous 
 step (i.e 8 hours) < if the voltage is 
 below 215 volts, put the battery under High Charging for 6 hours.

After finishing the step 5, and battery voltage is 
 still above 215V put the battery under normal charging then put it in service.

Record all 
 the readings you have read,

 MRDS
